instruction: Candid full-body documentary photograph in a subway station corridor with turnstiles in the background. On the left, the blonde woman in a striped crop top and jeans (R1) walks forward, looking ahead with a gentle smile. On the right, the bearded man in a blue long-sleeve shirt and khaki shorts (R2) walks in step with her, turning his head to look at her. They walk side-by-side while holding hands at waist level. Warm overhead fluorescent lights illuminate the tiled walkway, casting soft shadows and creating a warm atmosphere.
